# Ramoira Schema Specification

Open standard for brand identity in the agent web.

## Primary document

- [Schema Specification](SPEC.md): Complete format definition.
  Read this to understand the schema format, all five layers,
  field definitions, and lifecycle states.

## Layer reference

- [Identity layer](layers/identity.md)
- [Narrative layer](layers/narrative.md)  
- [Voice layer](layers/voice.md)
- [Commercial layer](layers/commercial.md)
- [Governance layer](layers/governance.md)

## Worked example

- [Little Rituals — full example](examples/little-rituals/README.md)
  Includes before/after LLM citation examples.
  Includes methodology reasoning.
  Primary reference for implementing the spec.
